title: Handover elements
description: elements.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/): the model resolved so a coding agent never parses the DSL. Written by Core.handoverElements at freeze, listed and hashed in handover.yaml. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-elements.example.json is the shared fixture.

elements.description: Every element of the model, in model order.

id.description: Hierarchical: the names from the software system down, joined by '/' (System/Container/Component). A person is its name.

code.description: d.code: where this element's code lives, as normalised repo path patterns (docs/path-patterns.json). Present only when declared.

risk.description: d.risk: how risky a change here is. Present only when declared.

relationships.description: Model relationships by element id, one per ordered pair.

events.description: Event names announced in behaviour/*.p (`announce <Name>`), by file path then first appearance, each once.
